mechanics.name: Inspirations
mechanics.body:
Inspirations are buffing skills used on yourself or allies costing Inspiration Points (IP), gained per level of Captain. Inspirations have a base range of **10m** and are preformed with a **Half Action** or **Extra Action**, unless otherwise stated.

Inspiration Points are reset to full after a Short or Long Rest. At the start of Combat gain Inspiration Points equal to half your Player Level rounded down, up to your maximum.

Inspirations may be used outside of combat in specific scenarios (ask your DM). Inspirations do not stack on the same target unless otherwise mentioned.

features.name: Captain at Arms
features.body: Gain Proficiencies in two melee weapon, one ranged weapon, two armours and one shield.

features.name: Inspirations
features.body: Gain a maximum of **2 Inspiration Points** (more as your Captain level increases) that you can spend on **Inspirations** to buff yourself or allies. Inspirations use a **Half Action** or **Extra Action**. At the start of Combat gain Inspiration Points equal to half your Player Level rounded down, up to your maximum. Inspiration Points are reset to full after a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Deliberation
features.body: As a **Full Action** you may spend specific amounts of Mana to gain Inspiration Points up to your maximum. Each Inspiration Point costs **3 Mana**.

abilities.name: Inspire Swiftness
abilities.body: Target gains **+6m** movement until the *end of their next turn*. Additionally, you may spend +1 Inspiration Points to increase that ally's *Initiative* by **+1d4+CHA**. Each ally can increase their Initiative this way once per combat. At Captain Level 6, increase their Initiative by **+1d6+CHA** instead. *After buffing initiative if an ally should have already had their turn, go right after you.*

abilities.name: Inspire Ferocity
abilities.body: Target gains **+1d6** to their *next* **Attack** roll this combat. If that attack lands, they deal and additional **+1d6** damage. If that ally defeats an enemy from the attack, gain **1 Inspiration Point**. Damage Dice Tier Dice Tier of the attack in increased by **+1** at Captain Levels **3, 6, and 9**. For each additional Inspiration Point spend on this, increase the Damage Dice Tier Count by +1.

abilities.name: Inspire Fortitude
abilities.body: Target ally gains **+2** to **AC** and **Spell AC** until the *start of your next turn*. Additionally, you may spend +1 Inspiration Points. If you do, the next time that ally takes damage, they take half damage. Boost the AC by an additional **+2** at Captain Level 6 and Player Levels 12 and 18.

abilities.name: Inspire Vigilance
abilities.body: Until the *start of your next turn*, all Attack and Spell Attacks against target have **Disadvantage**. Additionally they have **Advantage** on all **AGI** Checks. If the target is successfully hit with an Attack or Spell with this inspiration active, gain **+1 Inspiration Points**.

abilities.name: Inspire Courage
abilities.body: Target is cured of all Weak Debuffs. Until the *start of your next turn*, target cannot be afflicted by Weak mental Debuffs, and gains Advantage against saving throws from all other Debuffs.
